name: In My Eyes: The Monster.
source:
Living as a Monster.

Others see you as a threat as you get to their field of view. But do they know what it feels to be born as one? With not given choice, you're humanities threat.

You try and live what It should be considered a "normal life", but at what cost? At the cost of your sanity and multiple obsessive thoughts.

[From [url=https://redsythe.itch.io/in-my-eyes-the-monster]Itch.io[/url]]
